task_completion.description: The 'indi_simulator_dome' driver is active in the INDI control panel or telescope software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window showing the INDI Control Panel with 'indi_simulator_dome' listed and a green status indicator or 'Connect' button pressed.

task_completion.description: Dome slaving (syncing dome movement to telescope movement) is enabled in the settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle labeled 'Slave Dome', 'Dome Slaving', or similar is checked/active in the dome control interface.

task_completion.description: The agent slews the telescope/dome to Sirius, Canopus, and Alpha Centauri.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the telescope software targeting or tracking Sirius, Canopus, and Alpha Centauri sequentially.

task_completion.description: Synchronized azimuth telemetry is being recorded or compiled into a CSV format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or spreadsheet view showing 'dome_sync_report.csv' containing columns for target names and azimuth values.

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the slaving mechanism is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window showing 'dome_slaved_evidence.png' in the /home/ga/Documents/ folder.

task_completion.description: The final telemetry report is saved to the Documents directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file 'dome_sync_report.csv' exists in the /home/ga/Documents/ directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the astronomical software GUI rather than just writing the CSV via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with INDI controls or telescope tracking buttons.

integrity.description: The azimuth values in the report correspond to the actual positions of the stars at the simulated time.
integrity.visual_evidence: The azimuth values in the CSV match the coordinates shown in the telescope software UI during the slewing phase.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply 'echo' the final CSV content into a file without opening the observatory software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the observatory software (e.g., KStars, Ekos, or INDI panel) being opened and configured.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The site coordinates must be set to Latitude -31.2722 and Longitude 149.0661. The three required targets for telemetry are Sirius, Canopus, and Alpha Centauri. The driver name is 'indi_simulator_dome'. The report must be at /home/ga/Documents/dome_sync_report.csv and the image at /home/ga/Documents/dome_slaved_evidence.png.
